Class AlgoAccountPriorityService

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.service.AlgoAccountPriorityService
@Service public class AlgoAccountPriorityService extends Object
The security account priorities of an asset class or an instrument in an algo hierarchy (AlgoAssetclassSecurity.getIdSecurityaccount1() / AlgoAssetclassSecurity.getIdSecurityaccount2()).

A priority states where the user has found an instrument cheapest to trade, for example direct bonds only at the broker with the lowest bond commission. A simulation buys at that account and moves the missing cash there from the other brokers. The priority is therefore only meaningful for an account whose trading periods allow the instrument type at all, which is what the options offered in the dialog and the check on save both enforce.

Neither asks for a date. A simulation replays past years, so a period that has already ended still counts; whether it covers the day of a replayed fill is decided by the replay itself.

    • getOptions

      public List<ValueKeyHtmlSelectOptions> getOptions(Integer idTenant, Integer idSecuritycurrency, Integer idAssetClass)
      The security accounts of a tenant that may be named as priority for an instrument or an asset class, labelled portfolio / account and ordered that way.
      Parameters:
      idTenant - the tenant whose accounts are offered
      idSecuritycurrency - the instrument of an AlgoSecurity, or null
      idAssetClass - the asset class of an AlgoAssetclass, or null; with neither, as for a custom category, every account is offered
      Returns:
      the options, keyed by the id of the security account

    • validate

      public void validate(AlgoAssetclassSecurity node, Assetclass assetclass)
      Checks the priorities of an asset class or an instrument node before it is saved: both accounts belong to the tenant of the node, the second is only given together with a different first one, and, where the instrument type is known, the trading periods of each account allow it.
      Parameters:
      node - the node being saved, its security or asset class already resolved or at least carrying its id
      assetclass - the asset class the type is read from, or null for a custom category
      Throws:
      DataViolationException - when a rule is broken

    • assetclassOf

      public Assetclass assetclassOf(AlgoSecurity algoSecurity)
      The asset class that decides the instrument type of an instrument node.
      Parameters:
      algoSecurity - the node, carrying at least the id of its security
      Returns:
      the asset class, or null when the node carries no security
